profile.name: Alejandro Cerezo Gilarranz
profile.headline: Cybersecurity Analyst at IndraMind Cybersecurity (Cyber Risk & Compliance) | Telecommunications Engineer
profile.summary: Telecommunications Engineering graduate from the Universidad Politécnica de Madrid. He works at IndraMind Cybersecurity (formerly SIA), the Indra Group company specialised in cybersecurity, where he started as an intern in the GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) department and is now an analyst in the Cyber Risk & Compliance area. He is interested in risk management, regulatory compliance and building secure solutions in technology environments.

experience.description: Cybersecurity analyst in the Cyber Risk & Compliance area for financial services and audit clients. KPI tracking and risk analysis.
Curricular internship in the GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) department. Supported governance, risk and compliance tasks, mainly contributing to third-party risk assessment projects.
Contacted clients to offer tailored proposals based on their needs and the company's availability.
Ran the photo booth service at weddings and private parties.
Activity leader and coordinator at children's events with bouncy castles.

education.degree: Bachelor's Degree in Telecommunications Technologies and Services Engineering

certifications.name: DORA - The EU Digital Operational Resilience Act

projects.name: Portfolio AI Agent
projects.description: This website. An AI assistant that answers questions about his CV using tool calling, with a provider-agnostic backend (local models in development, a hosted model in production). It includes a contact form with real availability, signed approval links, calendar invitations and email delivery through the Gmail API, with rate limiting and input validation throughout.

interests.description: He has run 4 half marathons (3 in Segovia and 1 in Madrid) and the Behobia-San Sebastián (20 km).
He played youth football during high school and captained his local team for several years.
